# operonx

> An async graph engine for AI products: ops (Python functions) wired into graphs, run as one-off
> calls, batch jobs, or HTTP/websocket services. Streaming ops (`yield`), loops, branches, LLM and
> agent ops, run stores and replay.

The usage guide for coding assistants ships inside the package (`python -m operonx.guide` prints
its path) and every example in it is run by the test suite.

## Guide

- [Start here](operonx/guide/README.md): what operonx is, imports, the ten rules
- [Op types](operonx/guide/01-ops.md): @op, generators, @graph, LLMOp, agents, flow and retrieval ops
- [Composition](operonx/guide/02-composition.md): op → operon → Job / Runbook / Service → Application → operonx.toml
- [Control flow](operonx/guide/03-control-flow.md): streaming, loops, if/else, the ~ soft edge
- [Gotchas](operonx/guide/04-gotchas.md): failures that raise nothing
- [Project layout](operonx/guide/05-project-layout.md): how to lay out a product
